news.title: Studyportals and Made Impact partner to showcase personal international education stories

summary: Studyportals is dutch online education company, founded in 2009. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Studyportals is an Eindhoven-based study-choice platform for international students and an IND recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Runs what it calls the biggest educational search platform worldwide, with over three million visits a month from students around the world.

open.text: StudyPortals B.V. and StudyPortals Holding B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Its whole mission is making international higher education more transparent, so the work is international by nature.

growth.text: Says in its postings that it is looking to expand its team.

worth_knowing.text: Partnered with Made Impact to showcase personal stories of international education.
